entries.name: -----The World Itself, Adalanta-----
entries.content: The world, also known as Adalanta. It is a large world multiple times the size of earth, Covered in water with multiple continents. The world has 2 moons, with one main super continent that covers a good 40% of the world the continent is called Aria, it also has many islands and archipelagoes. The world is also laden with ruins and such of previous eras and civilizations. Time Wise, Adalanta is around the medieval period with some advancements due to magic.

entries.name: Aria
entries.content: Aria is the main landmass of the world, It has biomes and cultures of all types running across it. It has a fairly large desert in the middle where not much rain falls, But there are many types of forest, plains rainforest, and everything you can think of. And there is also the fast ocean and fast cave systems.

entries.name: Beastmen
entries.content: Beastmen are the main sentient inhabitants or the mortal realm. They take the shape of all types of anthropomorphic animals and creatures including fantasy ones, hybrids and even new species. They come in all shapes sizes and colors, and all have different life spans. They all call different parts of the World home. Beastmen are separated from their feral or monster counterparts.

entries.name: Gods
entries.content: The pantheon of gods mostly Live within their divine realm. The gods where mainly mortals that have ascended due to their actions and strength. Some gods take an active role in the world, blessing or even living in the mortal realm along side the mortals. Gods who live within the world often create divine cities around them. Some of the Gods have bodies that they can change on a whim or are ship shifters to put it a different way. There are 3 ways to ascend to god hood and both are hidden from most mortals, the first is to kill a god and take its place, the second is to have the current creation god ascend you and the 3rd, is to find the world tree's realm, and make a deal or connect yourself with it.

entries.name: Godly pantheon
entries.content: The current gods are the God of Creation, god of magic and knowledge, god of lust and fertility, god of war, god of smithing, god of food, god of the hunt, god of the sea, the god of life, the god of death.

entries.name: Divine Cities
entries.content: Divine cities are cities that are built around, or with the help of gods. The most known and interacted cities are the cities held by the gods of, lust, war, smithing, and magic. As these are the largest and the cities that are interacted with by their god the most. These cities, and the perimeter around them are neutral land not belonging to any country.

entries.name: Demons
entries.content: Demons are beings that come from the demonic realm, they have similar appearances to Beastmen but with obvious differences. They come to the mortal realm to corrupt mortals, and find pleasure. They are often semi magic attuned and fight with lust, They have been making more and more invasions and efforts to get into the mortal realm and Adalanta.

entries.name: Magic
entries.content: Magic is generally something anyone can learn, with the major caveat that a persons mana amount does not increase. Most people, are born with extremely small mana reserves to a point that if they did learn they can only cast basic spells. Some magic affinities are far harder to learn and wield based on how powerful they are, the simple elements like fire, earth, ect... are some of the easiest to learn while some examples of the hardest are, mimicry, spatial, stelar, and creation as examples due to how complex they are as magic types. Magic spells are generally casted with both magic circles, or incantations, and silent spell casting is a very rare ability. Some species that are naturally attuned to magic like Kitsune's, dragons, or hellhounds have their own species specific magic types that others of different species can not learn due to incompatibilities. Magic prowess is generally passed down through blood.

entries.name: Mana Zone
entries.content: Mana zone is the peak of magic and mage craft, it is the embodiment of a persons magical journey. Mana Zone is a technique where the user blankets the area in their mana and makes a field from their internal mind, This spell is different for every mage, and is learned differently for every mage, and as it is the peak of magic it is very rare to be able to use mana zone.

entries.name: Magic Hot spots
entries.content: Magic hot spots are areas that have developed or have had large amounts of magic around it, and the area now just naturally radiates magic, causing weird effects like reduced aging while inside and other small but noticeable effects

entries.name: Mana Mutations
entries.content: When a person is born with extremely high amounts of mana, the mana has a chance of mutating the body, these mutations can not be changed through transformative items. These mutations are things like extra body parts a species would not normally have, like horns on a wolf, or a fox with a tail that conducts magic. These mutations also can act as natural magic conduits some times.

entries.name: Corruption
entries.content: Corruption is gained in a couple ways, doing evil things, Working or doing things with demons, over use of transformitives on the body, and a few other ways, Corruption build up can cause change in behavior, and possibly even appearance.

entries.name: Transformitives
entries.content: Transformatives are Plants or items that can cause the body to transform by consuming it. Transformatives are separated into 3 categories. Species based, body based, and corrupted. Species based are linked to a species and consuming the transformative will cause you to take on some physical traits of the species, and your body changes to fit that species size ranges, Body based are based around genitals, and changing size and shape, or even adding new ones if possible. And corrupted do a mix of both while giving corruption and having more potent effects. Even when changing species through transformatives you don't loose traits or skills gained from being what you used to be.

entries.name: Dungeons
entries.content: Dungeons are magical hot spots that when magic gathers in an area for an extended period of time. These dungeons as they get older expand, and continually create monsters and items. The center point or end of a dungeon is where most of the mana if focused, and where   giant boss monsters are often made to protect it. When these monsters are killed and the magic destroyed the dungeon will become hallow, and stop producing items and Monsters. The older a dungeon the more powerful monsters and items it makes.

entries.name: Magic Items
entries.content: Magic items are anything that have innate magic within them and have some sort of effect on the user. Magic items can be obtained in a few ways, You can have a normal item enchanted, one of the weaker ways, you can use a magical metal, and have magic poured in during the forging process, you can get them from dungeons if you are lucky, or if a item is blessed in some way by a god or entity.

entries.name: Monsters
entries.content: Monsters are generally lower intelligent while still somewhat sentient beast. They can either be slightly anthro, or feral like. They are things like Dire wolves, goblins(Beastmen like), fey(Beastmen like), feral dragons, Rocs and other such creatures. Monsters created by dungeons are more akin to copies of actual monsters.

entries.name: The sky
entries.content: The sky of the world is not a normal sky, while the inhabitants of the world can see past the sky they cannot leave their worlds boarders. Due to the Barrier around the sky that was forced up by the sky god, Any who try and leave Adalanta's Boarders, will fall to the ground. Many a mortal have tried and failed. But the fact of the sky barrier is something only known amongst those who have delved into the history of the world and the gods.

entries.name: The world tree
entries.content: The world tree is a massive tree that resides in its semi realm. Its roots connect all over the world, It is the center of the worlds magic, and also the center of its rules and laws. The world tree, at the beginning of every new era will make or pick someone to be its avatar for that time. The world tree's main goal is the preservation of the world, no matter what. It is while the Center of Adalanta, is only a small branch of an even more cosmic thing. Those who come in contact with the world tree, often find themselves blessed with power.

They formed around the Usurped god of the skies. They work to oppose the gods and the worlds very rules. They are headed by the divine conciseness of the god of the sky, and his most loyal followers, the 13 sky chasers. As an organization they do many thing and are willing to do what ever it takes to reach their final goal, the war of the gods and the restoration of the sky god.
